title: Very good to do list
body:
Reminders is very effective to do list which can be used for organizing and prioritizing daily task or planning for weekly commitments. 

Regarding the enhancements opportunities, I suggested to add the option to have sound alert for task which is due where the person can activate or deactivate the sound feature.

Second suggestion to AI to support open other applications or contact some depends on the reminders nature. I believe this will make reminders like personal assistant. 

Third suggestion, I’m not sure if this feature is there but it will be good if it is there for people who want to write a reminder but they can’t for various reasons. The feature I’m suggesting is the speech to text feature.

However I loved it and I will keep using it.
